chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Muhammad ibn Hakim, who said:

I asked Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام about a man who married off his female slave to another man, then said to her, 'When the husband dies, she is free.' Then the husband died, so he said: 'When the husband dies, she is free; she must observe the waiting period of a free woman whose husband has died, and there is no inheritance for her from him, because she only became free after the death of the husband.'

key_terms.تَعْتَدُّ: she observes the legally prescribed waiting period
key_terms.عِدَّةَ: the waiting period required by law after the end of marriage
key_terms.ٱلْمُتَوَفَّى: the one whose spouse has died

ai.seo_question: If a female slave becomes free only when her husband dies, does she inherit from him and what 'iddah must she observe?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a female slave whose freedom was made conditional upon her husband's death. Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام states that after the husband's death she observes the 'iddah of a free widow, but she does not inherit from him because her freedom only took effect after his death.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4643 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Muhammad ibn Hakim who said:

I asked Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) about a man who married off his female slave to another man and then told her, "When your husband dies, you will be free."
The husband then died.
Imam (as) said: "When the husband dies, she becomes free and must observe the waiting period (iddah) of a free woman whose husband has passed away. However, she does not inherit from him because she only became free after the husband's death."
